entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: ...About time you've come to.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: On your feet, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Our master wishes to speak with you.[n]It's for your own sake that you take his[n]words to heart.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: First off, let us celebrate our reunion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Oh...? You've awakened to your powers—[n]and special ones at that.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your rehabilitation can finally begin.
My powers?
Rehabilitation?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: There is no need to understand it all for[n]the time being.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You will be training the power of Persona,[n]which you have awakened to.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Personas are, in other words, a "mask"—[n]an armor of the heart when confronting[n]worldly matters.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I have high expectations for you.
What do you mean?
That's not my concern.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: There is no need to worry. You will learn[n]when the time comes.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Do you really think you have a say[n]in this!?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You have no choice but to hone your[n]strength.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It's not because we're forcing you, but[n]because this is your fate... Neglect it and[n]you will die.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: By the by... have you come to appreciate[n]the Metaverse Navigator?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Using it will allow you to come and go[n]between reality and Palaces.
Palaces?
Metaverse Navigator?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: ...I bestowed it to you as a means to[n]train you as a thief.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: The Metaverse Navigator is a gift from[n]our master! You better take care in using[n]it, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Devote yourself to your training so that[n]you may become a fine thief.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It must be disheartening to make use of[n]the Metaverse Navigator alone.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Should there be others who would prove[n]beneficial to you, I will grant it to them[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: This is all for you to grow as a most[n]excellent thief...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hmph, it's time. Go back and enjoy[n]whatever rest you might have...
